mapper.select: SELECT LINK_SYS_CD AS linkSysCd, LINK_SYS_NM AS linkSysNm, PROTCL_CD AS protclCd FROM link_sys_info WHERE USE_YN='Y' ORDER BY FIELD(LINK_SYS_CD,'EMS_TX','EMS_PIDS','SCADA_SEC','PBX','VMS'), LINK_SYS_NM
SELECT STN_CD AS stnCd, STN_NM AS stnNm FROM stn_info WHERE USE_YN='Y' ORDER BY STN_SEQ

SELECT I.PERF_IDCT_CD AS perfIdctCd, I.PERF_IDCT_NM AS perfIdctNm, I.UNIT_NM AS unitNm, CASE MAX(CASE P.STTS_CD WHEN 'EMERGENCY' THEN 6 WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 5 WHEN 'LOW' THEN 4 WHEN 'WARNING' THEN 3 WHEN 'INFO' THEN 2 WHEN 'CLEAR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) WHEN 6 THEN 'EMERGENCY' WHEN 5 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN 4 THEN 'LOW' WHEN 3 THEN 'WARNING' WHEN 2 THEN 'INFO' WHEN 1 THEN 'CLEAR' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS sttsCd, MAX(P.CLCT_DT) AS lastClctDt FROM perf_idct_info I LEFT JOIN eqpmnt_perf_stts P ON P.PERF_IDCT_CD=I.PERF_IDCT_CD LEFT JOIN eqpmnt_info E ON E.EQPMNT_SN=P.EQPMNT_SN WHERE I.USE_YN='Y' AND I.PERF_IDCT_CD IN ('CPU_USGRT','MMRY_USGRT') AND (E.LINK_SYS_CD=#{linkSysCd} OR E.EQPMNT_SN IS NULL) AND (E.STN_CD=#{stnCd} OR E.EQPMNT_SN IS NULL) AND (E.EQPMNT_SN=#{eqpmntSn} OR E.EQPMNT_SN IS NULL) GROUP BY I.PERF_IDCT_CD,I.PERF_IDCT_NM,I.UNIT_NM

SELECT E.EQPMNT_SN AS eqpmntSn, E.EQPMNT_NM AS eqpmntNm, E.EQPMNT_MNG_NO AS eqpmntMngNo, E.LINK_SYS_CD AS linkSysCd, L.LINK_SYS_NM AS linkSysNm, E.STN_CD AS stnCd, S.STN_NM AS stnNm, E.EQPMNT_IP_ADDR AS ipAddr, E.EQPMNT_SE_CD AS eqpmntSeCd, L.PROTCL_CD AS protclCd, (SELECT C.CLCT_CYCLE_SEC FROM clct_cycle_info C WHERE C.LINK_SYS_CD=E.LINK_SYS_CD AND C.DATA_SE_CD='P' AND C.USE_YN='Y' LIMIT 1) AS clctCycleSec, MAX(CASE WHEN P.PERF_IDCT_CD='CPU_USGRT' THEN P.MSRMT_VL END) AS cpuUsgrt, MAX(CASE WHEN P.PERF_IDCT_CD='MMRY_USGRT' THEN P.MSRMT_VL END) AS mmryUsgrt, MAX(CASE WHEN P.PERF_IDCT_CD='TRFC_USGRT' THEN P.MSRMT_VL END) AS trfcUsgrt, MAX(CASE WHEN P.PERF_IDCT_CD='ERR_PKT_RT' THEN P.MSRMT_VL END) AS errPktRt, MAX(CASE WHEN P.PERF_IDCT_CD='PING_RSPNS_MS' THEN P.MSRMT_VL END) AS pingRspnsMs, MAX(CASE WHEN P.PERF_IDCT_CD='IF_USE_NOCS' THEN P.MSRMT_VL END) AS ifUseNocs, MAX(CASE WHEN P.PERF_IDCT_CD='IF_TOTAL_NOCS' THEN P.MSRMT_VL END) AS ifTotalNocs, MAX(P.CLCT_DT) AS lastClctDt, CASE MAX(CASE P.STTS_CD WHEN 'EMERGENCY' THEN 6 WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 5 WHEN 'LOW' THEN 4 WHEN 'WARNING' THEN 3 WHEN 'INFO' THEN 2 WHEN 'CLEAR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) WHEN 6 THEN 'EMERGENCY' WHEN 5 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN 4 THEN 'LOW' WHEN 3 THEN 'WARNING' WHEN 2 THEN 'INFO' WHEN 1 THEN 'CLEAR' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS sttsCd FROM eqpmnt_info E JOIN link_sys_info L ON L.LINK_SYS_CD=E.LINK_SYS_CD LEFT JOIN stn_info S ON S.STN_CD=E.STN_CD LEFT JOIN eqpmnt_perf_stts P ON P.EQPMNT_SN=E.EQPMNT_SN WHERE GROUP BY E.EQPMNT_SN,E.EQPMNT_NM,E.EQPMNT_MNG_NO,E.LINK_SYS_CD,L.LINK_SYS_NM,E.STN_CD,S.STN_NM,E.EQPMNT_IP_ADDR,E.EQPMNT_SE_CD ORDER BY MAX(P.CLCT_DT) DESC, COALESCE(S.STN_SEQ,999), E.EQPMNT_NM LIMIT 200

SELECT E.EQPMNT_SN AS eqpmntSn, E.EQPMNT_NM AS eqpmntNm, E.EQPMNT_MNG_NO AS eqpmntMngNo, P.MSRMT_VL AS value, P.UNIT_NM AS unitNm, P.STTS_CD AS sttsCd, P.CLCT_DT AS clctDt FROM eqpmnt_perf_stts P JOIN eqpmnt_info E ON E.EQPMNT_SN=P.EQPMNT_SN AND E.USE_YN='Y' WHERE P.PERF_IDCT_CD=#{topIndicator} AND P.PERF_IDCT_CD IN ('CPU_USGRT','MMRY_USGRT') AND E.LINK_SYS_CD=#{linkSysCd} AND E.STN_CD=#{stnCd} ORDER BY P.MSRMT_VL DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT C.CLCT_CYCLE_SN AS clctCycleSn, C.LINK_SYS_CD AS linkSysCd, L.LINK_SYS_NM AS linkSysNm, C.DATA_SE_CD AS dataSeCd, CASE C.DATA_SE_CD WHEN 'P' THEN '성능·상태' WHEN 'F' THEN '장애·상태' WHEN 'C' THEN '구성' WHEN 'S' THEN '보안' ELSE C.DATA_SE_CD END AS dataSeNm, L.PROTCL_CD AS performanceProtocol, 'ICMP' AS pingProtocol, C.CLCT_CYCLE_SEC AS clctCycleSec, C.STTS_MNTR_CYCLE_SEC AS sttsMntrCycleSec, C.TIMEOUT_SEC AS timeoutSec, C.RTRY_NOCS AS rtryNocs, C.LAST_EXCN_DT AS lastExcnDt, C.NEXT_EXCN_DT AS nextExcnDt, C.USE_YN AS useYn, C.CYCLE_CRTR_CN AS cycleCrtrCn, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eqpmnt_info E2 WHERE E2.LINK_SYS_CD=C.LINK_SYS_CD AND E2.USE_YN='Y') AS targetEqpmntCount FROM clct_cycle_info C JOIN link_sys_info L ON L.LINK_SYS_CD=C.LINK_SYS_CD WHERE 1=1 AND C.LINK_SYS_CD=#{linkSysCd} AND C.DATA_SE_CD=#{dataSeCd} ORDER BY FIELD(C.LINK_SYS_CD,'EMS_TX','EMS_PIDS','SCADA_SEC','PBX','VMS'), C.DATA_SE_CD

SELECT C.LINK_SYS_CD AS linkSysCd, L.LINK_SYS_NM AS linkSysNm, DATE_FORMAT(H.EXCN_BGNG_DT,'%H') AS hourLabel, COUNT(*) AS executionCount, SUM(H.SCS_NOCS) AS successNocs, SUM(H.FAIL_NOCS) AS failNocs, CASE WHEN SUM(H.FAIL_NOCS) > 0 OR SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(H.STTS_CD) IN ('FAIL','FAILED','ERROR') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'FAIL' WHEN COUNT(*) < GREATEST(1,FLOOR(3600 / C.CLCT_CYCLE_SEC)) THEN 'DELAY' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS execSttsCd FROM clct_excn_hstry H JOIN clct_cycle_info C ON C.CLCT_CYCLE_SN=H.CLCT_CYCLE_SN AND C.DATA_SE_CD='P' JOIN link_sys_info L ON L.LINK_SYS_CD=C.LINK_SYS_CD WHERE H.EXCN_BGNG_DT >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) AND C.LINK_SYS_CD=#{linkSysCd} GROUP BY C.LINK_SYS_CD,L.LINK_SYS_NM,C.CLCT_CYCLE_SEC,DATE_FORMAT(H.EXCN_BGNG_DT,'%Y-%m-%d %H') ORDER BY FIELD(C.LINK_SYS_CD,'EMS_TX','EMS_PIDS','SCADA_SEC','PBX','VMS'), MIN(H.EXCN_BGNG_DT)

SELECT C.CLCT_CYCLE_SN AS clctCycleSn, C.LINK_SYS_CD AS linkSysCd, L.LINK_SYS_NM AS linkSysNm, C.DATA_SE_CD AS dataSeCd, C.CLCT_CYCLE_SEC AS clctCycleSec, C.STTS_MNTR_CYCLE_SEC AS sttsMntrCycleSec, C.TIMEOUT_SEC AS timeoutSec, C.RTRY_NOCS AS rtryNocs, C.USE_YN AS useYn, C.CYCLE_CRTR_CN AS cycleCrtrCn, L.PROTCL_CD AS performanceProtocol, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eqpmnt_info E2 WHERE E2.LINK_SYS_CD=C.LINK_SYS_CD AND E2.USE_YN='Y') AS targetEqpmntCount FROM clct_cycle_info C JOIN link_sys_info L ON L.LINK_SYS_CD=C.LINK_SYS_CD WHERE C.CLCT_CYCLE_SN=#{_parameter}

SELECT T.THRSHLD_SN AS thrshldSn, I.PERF_IDCT_CD AS perfIdctCd, I.PERF_IDCT_NM AS perfIdctNm, I.UNIT_NM AS unitNm, T.LINK_SYS_CD AS linkSysCd, L.LINK_SYS_NM AS linkSysNm, T.EQPMNT_SE_CD AS eqpmntSeCd, T.INFO_VL AS infoVl, T.WARNING_VL AS warningVl, T.LOW_VL AS lowVl, T.HIGH_VL AS highVl, T.EMERGENCY_VL AS emergencyVl, T.CMPR_OPRTR_CD AS cmprOprtrCd, COALESCE(T.CONTN_NOCS,3) AS contnNocs, COALESCE(T.ALRM_USE_YN,'Y') AS alrmUseYn, COALESCE(T.USE_YN,'Y') AS useYn FROM perf_idct_info I LEFT JOIN thrshld_info T ON T.PERF_IDCT_CD=I.PERF_IDCT_CD LEFT JOIN link_sys_info L ON L.LINK_SYS_CD=T.LINK_SYS_CD WHERE I.USE_YN='Y' AND I.PERF_IDCT_CD IN ('CPU_USGRT','MMRY_USGRT') AND (T.LINK_SYS_CD=#{linkSysCd} OR T.LINK_SYS_CD IS NULL) AND (I.PERF_IDCT_CD LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR I.PERF_IDCT_NM LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) ORDER BY FIELD(I.PERF_IDCT_CD,'CPU_USGRT','MMRY_USGRT'), T.THRSHLD_SN

SELECT T.THRSHLD_SN AS thrshldSn,T.LINK_SYS_CD AS linkSysCd,T.EQPMNT_SE_CD AS eqpmntSeCd,T.PERF_IDCT_CD AS perfIdctCd, I.PERF_IDCT_NM AS perfIdctNm,I.UNIT_NM AS unitNm,T.INFO_VL AS infoVl,T.WARNING_VL AS warningVl,T.LOW_VL AS lowVl,T.HIGH_VL AS highVl,T.EMERGENCY_VL AS emergencyVl, T.CMPR_OPRTR_CD AS cmprOprtrCd,COALESCE(T.CONTN_NOCS,3) AS contnNocs,T.ALRM_USE_YN AS alrmUseYn,T.USE_YN AS useYn FROM thrshld_info T JOIN perf_idct_info I ON I.PERF_IDCT_CD=T.PERF_IDCT_CD WHERE T.THRSHLD_SN=#{_parameter}

SELECT T.THRSHLD_SN AS thrshldSn,T.LINK_SYS_CD AS linkSysCd,T.EQPMNT_SE_CD AS eqpmntSeCd,T.PERF_IDCT_CD AS perfIdctCd, I.PERF_IDCT_NM AS perfIdctNm,I.UNIT_NM AS unitNm,T.INFO_VL AS infoVl,T.WARNING_VL AS warningVl,T.LOW_VL AS lowVl,T.HIGH_VL AS highVl,T.EMERGENCY_VL AS emergencyVl, T.CMPR_OPRTR_CD AS cmprOprtrCd,COALESCE(T.CONTN_NOCS,3) AS contnNocs,T.ALRM_USE_YN AS alrmUseYn,T.USE_YN AS useYn FROM thrshld_info T JOIN perf_idct_info I ON I.PERF_IDCT_CD=T.PERF_IDCT_CD WHERE T.PERF_IDCT_CD=#{_parameter} ORDER BY T.THRSHLD_SN LIMIT 1

choose.when: SELECT H.STATS_HR_DT AS clctDt, '1시간 통계' AS dataTypeNm, E.LINK_SYS_CD AS linkSysCd, L.LINK_SYS_NM AS linkSysNm, S.STN_NM AS stnNm, E.EQPMNT_NM AS eqpmntNm, E.EQPMNT_MNG_NO AS eqpmntMngNo, MAX(CASE WHEN H.PERF_IDCT_CD='CPU_USGRT' THEN H.AVG_VL END) AS cpuUsgrt, MAX(CASE WHEN H.PERF_IDCT_CD='MMRY_USGRT' THEN H.AVG_VL END) AS mmryUsgrt FROM perf_hr_stats H JOIN eqpmnt_info E ON E.EQPMNT_SN=H.EQPMNT_SN JOIN link_sys_info L ON L.LINK_SYS_CD=E.LINK_SYS_CD LEFT JOIN stn_info S ON S.STN_CD=E.STN_CD WHERE E.USE_YN='Y' AND H.STATS_HR_DT>=#{startDt}AND H.STATS_HR_DT<=#{endDt} AND E.LINK_SYS_CD=#{linkSysCd}AND E.STN_CD=#{stnCd} AND (E.EQPMNT_NM LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR E.EQPMNT_MNG_NO LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) GROUP BY H.STATS_HR_DT,E.EQPMNT_SN,E.LINK_SYS_CD,L.LINK_SYS_NM,S.STN_NM,E.EQPMNT_NM,E.EQPMNT_MNG_NO ORDER BY H.STATS_HR_DT DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT H.STATS_YMD AS clctDt, '1일 통계' AS dataTypeNm, E.LINK_SYS_CD AS linkSysCd, L.LINK_SYS_NM AS linkSysNm, S.STN_NM AS stnNm, E.EQPMNT_NM AS eqpmntNm, E.EQPMNT_MNG_NO AS eqpmntMngNo, MAX(CASE WHEN H.PERF_IDCT_CD='CPU_USGRT' THEN H.AVG_VL END) AS cpuUsgrt, MAX(CASE WHEN H.PERF_IDCT_CD='MMRY_USGRT' THEN H.AVG_VL END) AS mmryUsgrt FROM perf_day_stats H JOIN eqpmnt_info E ON E.EQPMNT_SN=H.EQPMNT_SN JOIN link_sys_info L ON L.LINK_SYS_CD=E.LINK_SYS_CD LEFT JOIN stn_info S ON S.STN_CD=E.STN_CD WHERE E.USE_YN='Y' AND H.STATS_YMD>=DATE(#{startDt})AND H.STATS_YMD<=DATE(#{endDt}) AND E.LINK_SYS_CD=#{linkSysCd}AND E.STN_CD=#{stnCd} AND (E.EQPMNT_NM LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR E.EQPMNT_MNG_NO LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) GROUP BY H.STATS_YMD,E.EQPMNT_SN,E.LINK_SYS_CD,L.LINK_SYS_NM,S.STN_NM,E.EQPMNT_NM,E.EQPMNT_MNG_NO ORDER BY H.STATS_YMD DESC LIMIT 500
choose.otherwise: SELECT P.CLCT_DT AS clctDt, 'Raw Data' AS dataTypeNm, E.LINK_SYS_CD AS linkSysCd, L.LINK_SYS_NM AS linkSysNm, S.STN_NM AS stnNm, E.EQPMNT_NM AS eqpmntNm, E.EQPMNT_MNG_NO AS eqpmntMngNo, MAX(CASE WHEN P.PERF_IDCT_CD='CPU_USGRT' THEN P.MSRMT_VL END) AS cpuUsgrt, MAX(CASE WHEN P.PERF_IDCT_CD='MMRY_USGRT' THEN P.MSRMT_VL END) AS mmryUsgrt FROM perf_raw_data P JOIN eqpmnt_info E ON E.EQPMNT_SN=P.EQPMNT_SN JOIN link_sys_info L ON L.LINK_SYS_CD=E.LINK_SYS_CD LEFT JOIN stn_info S ON S.STN_CD=E.STN_CD WHERE E.USE_YN='Y' AND P.CLCT_DT>=#{startDt}AND P.CLCT_DT<=#{endDt} AND E.LINK_SYS_CD=#{linkSysCd}AND E.STN_CD=#{stnCd} AND (E.EQPMNT_NM LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR E.EQPMNT_MNG_NO LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) GROUP BY P.CLCT_DT,E.EQPMNT_SN,E.LINK_SYS_CD,L.LINK_SYS_NM,S.STN_NM,E.EQPMNT_NM,E.EQPMNT_MNG_NO ORDER BY P.CLCT_DT DESC LIMIT 500

mapper.select: SELECT R.LINK_RAW_SN AS linkRawSn, R.CLCT_DT AS clctDt, R.LINK_SYS_CD AS linkSysCd, L.LINK_SYS_NM AS linkSysNm, R.MSG_TYPE_NM AS msgTypeNm, R.TRSM_DRCT_NM AS trsmDrctNm, R.SOU_IP_ADDR AS souIpAddr, R.SOU_PORT_NO AS souPortNo, R.DATA_SE_CD AS dataSeCd, R.CLCT_STTS_CD AS clctSttsCd, R.ERR_CN AS errCn FROM link_raw_data R JOIN link_sys_info L ON L.LINK_SYS_CD=R.LINK_SYS_CD WHERE 1=1 AND R.CLCT_DT>=#{startDt}AND R.CLCT_DT<=#{endDt} AND R.LINK_SYS_CD=#{linkSysCd} AND (R.MSG_TYPE_NM LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR R.SOU_IP_ADDR LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR R.RAW_DATA LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) ORDER BY R.CLCT_DT DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM perf_raw_data) AS rawCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM perf_hr_stats) AS hourCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM perf_day_stats) AS dayCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM link_raw_data) AS interfaceCount
